items.t: Enbridge Eyes $1 Billion Pipeline Deal With Indigenous Communities
items.sum: Enbridge is reportedly negotiating a C$1.5 billion sale of a 6% stake in its Line 3 pipeline network to a coalition of Indigenous communities.

items.t: Enbridge: Yield Is Very Attractive, But Performance Is Underwhelming
items.sum: Enbridge offers a 5.92% yield, but its dividend has declined in real terms, and its total returns have lagged Canadian midstream peers.
